en.headline: Worker injured after forklift falls from platform at Kwai Chung logistics centre
en.dek: A 65-year-old man remained conscious after the vehicle and he fell about 1.3 metres at a Hutchison facility; police are investigating.
body: Police said a 65-year-old male worker was injured on Tuesday afternoon when a forklift he was driving fell from a loading platform at a logistics centre in Kwai Chung.

Officers received a report at about 5:27pm that the man and the forklift had fallen from a platform roughly 1.3 metres high at Hutchison Logistics Centre on Container Port Road South. He was briefly trapped but remained conscious.
Rescuers freed him and paramedics treated him at the scene before an ambulance took him to Princess Margaret Hospital with a head injury. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.

zh.headline: 葵涌物流中心男工連人帶叉車墮載貨台 頭部受傷送院
zh.dek: 65歲男工人於貨櫃碼頭南路和黃物流中心駕駛叉車時連人帶車由約1.3米高平台墮下，一度被困，清醒送瑪嘉烈醫院，警方調查中。
body: 警方表示，周二下午一名65歲男工人在葵涌物流中心駕駛叉車時發生意外，連人帶車由載貨台墮下受傷。
警方於下午約5時27分接報，指貨櫃碼頭南路18號和黃物流中心內，該名工人疑駕駛叉車時連人帶車由約1.3米高的載貨台墮下，一度被困，但仍保持清醒。
救援人員到場將他救出，救護員初步治理後由救護車送往瑪嘉烈醫院，抵院時頭部有紗布包裹。警方正調查意外原因。
